citations.narrative:
The facility's budgie aviary does not currently contain the birds securely. At the time of inspection, the inspector saw one
adult budgie on the outside wall of the enclosure. After reviewing the enclosure with the facility representatives, it is likely
that the budgie escaped by digging under the primary door and through a gap around the secondary door. A facility
representative was able to return the budgie to its enclosure without harm during the inspection.
Birds that are able to escape their enclosure can fly away, get injured, or be killed. Primary enclosures must be
constructed and maintained so that they contain the birds securely.
To be corrected by August 4, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representatives.
